  first.value = GoLean.GoValue.interface GoLean.GoCore.Ty.string (GoLean.GoValue.string bytes) →
    ∀ (ch : GoLean.GoCore.Choices) (rs : GoLean.GoCore.Machine.RaceState) (out : GoLean.GoString),
      GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.execPoolWithAbort (fuel + 1)
          (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.MultiConfig.mk
            #[GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Thread.running
                (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Config.panicking (first :: rest) GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Cont.stop) none]
            s 0)
          rs ch out =
        ((out, Except.error (GoLean.Stop.panic (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.stringPanicHead bytes first.recovered))),
          GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.abortRecord?
            (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Config.panicking (first :: rest) GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Cont.stop))
